reviews.title: Excelente por calidad y precio
reviews.comment: Excelente por calidad y precio. Ideal para estudiantes de programación de software. Se integra perfectamente con las memorias Ram Crucial de 16 gigas cada una y el equipo trabaja muy bien a pesar de tener un procesador sencillo Intel core 12400F que carece de tarjeta gráfica interna y obliga instalar una Tarjeta Gráfica en la mother board.
reviews.author: Walter P.

reviews.title: Not what’s pictured
reviews.comment: The board pictured has multiple PCIe 16 slots. What comes is just one 16x slot. It’s a smaller board than that pictured. Misleading.
reviews.author: reviewer

reviews.title: So far so good, had one hiccup
reviews.comment: So the motherboard is now working very well. When we first got it all together , we coudnt get past POST. We read the led wrong and thought it was ram, tested ram, no not the ram. Restarted and saw that it was VGA lit up in POST. Ok so GPU issue. We knew the GPU worked, we had tested it on another mobo. We disconnected the GPU and retried. Yes, went right into bios. Turns out, that we needed to change the pcie slot off auto. Managed to get through POST into bios with GPU connected. Installed Windows and the PC is running fantastic. Gigabyte does have a schematic on their site to help with connecting your power supply and rgb if you’re new to PC building.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer
